action_items: OPTIONAL UX polish (not a bug): dr-continue button on title screen is enabled even for a truly-new user whose server-side trusted progress is fully empty — because the local save object is populated by client-side new-game. On the fresh reset for founder we still saw Continue enabled from a prior save; behaviour is per-spec but could confuse first-time users. Consider gating dr-continue on save_version>0 AND trusted.discovered/befriended/first_defeats non-empty OR client save.explored=true.

OPTIONAL testability: dr-title Pixel wrapper is present in the DOM but Playwright's is_visible() returns false against the outer testid (visible descendants are what render). Non-blocking (dr-new-game and inner testids work fine) but future tests should wait on dr-new-game or the inner Pixel content rather than dr-title.
critical_code_review_comments: services/dragon_realm.py::record_event lines 124-131: the try/except around ISO parsing of last_event_at catches ValueError with `raise` (correct) but the bare Exception fallback silently `pass`es. If last_event_at is stored corrupt, rate-limit is skipped silently rather than logged. Consider explicit warn-log so a bad-timestamp regression is visible.

services/dragon_realm.py::claim_reward line 197: `collect_fire(user, [txn['id']])` runs BEFORE the save doc is stamped `claimed` (lines 199-204). If collect_fire raises AFTER credit_fire+settle_due succeed but BEFORE the doc update, the reward is credited to the wallet AND still shows 'claiming' in the doc — the except at 205 then flips it back to 'unclaimed', enabling a double-credit path. Recommendation: stamp `claimed` first, then run collect_fire (which is Vault-move only), OR make the rollback branch idempotency-aware (e.g. check idem key already exists in ledger and if so, only stamp claimed without rolling back).

routers/dragon_realm.py::admin_config_put line 100: `access_mode` validation allows 'launch' but user_allowed (services/dragon_realm.py:87) only checks 'live'/'launch' — small nit: keep the accepted set in one constant and reference from both places to prevent drift.
DragonRealmRuntime.jsx line 166 Continue button `disabled={!state.save}` uses client `save`, not server trusted progress — see action item above.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression file: /app/backend/tests/test_dragon_realm.py — module-load loads /app/backend/.env for the classification test.
